title: Oven Roasted German Pork Skillet
description: A sweet and crispy solo dinner dish featuring cocoa powder, air-fried and cooked in a paella pan, with Mediterranean-friendly ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the pork shoulder with salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Heat the olive oil in the paella pan over medium-high heat.
Air-fry the pork shoulder in the paella pan until browned on all sides.
Add the chopped onion to the paella pan and cook until softened.
Add the minced garlic to the paella pan and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes to the paella pan and cook for 5 minutes.
Sprinkle the cocoa powder over the pork shoulder and vegetables.
Transfer the paella pan to the preheated oven and roast for 25 minutes.
Remove the paella pan from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
